title: U55 public planning interface re-exports

claims.text: The module re-exports PlanError plus the template helpers canonical_template_json, template_hash, validate_template, load_template and resolve_template.

The module re-exports the op shape helpers validate_op_shape and is_valid_op_shape, the fold functions empty_projection, apply_op_event and fold_plan, check_conformance, and the renderers render_plan_md and render_memory_md.

triggers: plan template helper missing from planning imports

decision.rule: Change here when the public U55 planning interface surface needs to change.
decision.failure: A planning consumer imports a helper that this module no longer re-exports.

questions.q: Which planning helpers does this module re-export as the U55 public interface?
Where should I change the public planning interface after a helper is renamed?
